source.title: Therapy contract-payment platform build plan, Rules reference tab as of 2026-10-14 (copy of docs/product/rules-reference.md)
source.transcribed_by: milestone 0 part B build session, first pass
source.locator: Therapy-specific Medicare rules table, rows "KX modifier threshold" and "Targeted medical review threshold" (lines 24 and 25)

questions: Open the CMS therapy services page (https://www.cms.gov/medicare/coding-billing/therapy-services) and the CY 2026 physician fee schedule final rule: is the 2026 KX threshold for PT and SLP combined $2,480, and the targeted medical review threshold $3,000?
Store that CMS page or the final rule under content/sources/therapy_threshold/ and re-cite this record to it, quoting the stored file; the plan's rules reference is a secondary source.
Is the window right (calendar year 2026 only), with 2027 to come as its own record?

quotes: $2,480 for PT and SLP combined; $2,480 for OT (2026)
$3,000 for PT and SLP; $3,000 for OT (2026); indexed by the MEI from 2028
notes: Hand-typed from the plan's rules reference, which cites CMS therapy services (https://www.cms.gov/medicare/coding-billing/therapy-services); the plan read the values from that page on 2026-10-14. Not yet read against a CMS document stored in this repository. A review flag for the engine, never a price change.
